completion_gate: Both specifications exist, are marked approved, and pre-register their statistics, thresholds, null objects and stopping rules.
Neither contract states a time, memory or run ceiling.
The opening report records both Section 8 determinations and EXP-HEUR-d640d9's explicit ceiling.
constraints: Both contracts are FROZEN before execution and are not revised in light of results. A needed change is a superseding contract under a new id.

EXP-HEUR-d640d9 must pre-register, before any datum: the prime range and enumeration method for ground truth; the sampler under test and the two-sample statistic comparing walk-sampled against enumerated delta_E; the exact parity statistic P(delta_E even) with binomial error bars stratified by p mod 8 and its rejection threshold; the size-model double fit (against Psi(n,B)/n with n the actual delta_E AND against Psi(X,B)/X with X = (p/2)^{1/3}) with the discrimination criterion; and the disjointness ratio (iii)/(i) with the value that would count as bounded away from 1.

EXP-HEUR-d640d9 must carry a NULL OBJECT of the same shape per docs/inventor-protocol.md, and an instrument-fidelity control on a case with an exactly known count. State the void criterion: a signal that survives the null is an artifact.

State plainly in EXP-HEUR-d640d9 what it CANNOT do: Heuristic 1 is a tail statement at u ~ 13 and toy primes cannot reach that tail. This measures the body and the sampler, and its honest ceiling is to falsify or fail to falsify the MODEL, never to confirm the heuristic. A pass is not evidence for the attack.

EXP-PEC-d7979c must pre-register NC2d-PROPER (C-PSCALE at ell in {47,101,151,211}, chosen ABOVE the Karatsuba threshold so the ell in {3,5} artifact RT3-C3 identified cannot drive it) with the alpha band and the rule fixing the primary designation across every outcome BEFORE the number is seen; NC2b-SLOPE (a synthetic slope null with known ground truth, the only gate with power against L1); and L2-WEIGHT (the entry-weighted charging correction, exact enumeration plus the Dickman comparator, with its sign stated in advance).
The NC2b gate tolerance in EXP-PEC-49c773 had NO VARIANCE TERM (Validator V-1). Any tolerance in EXP-PEC-d7979c must derive one or state explicitly that it does not and what that costs in power.
Restate the standing prohibitions in both contracts so no Executor can cite a forbidden value.
Assess docs/inventor-protocol.md Section 8 for each contract and record the determination with its reason.

Declare stopping rules in scientific terms. There is NO BUDGET: no wall clock, no memory ceiling, no run cap. A contract may not say 'stop after N seconds'. It must say what result or condition ends the experiment, and what a partial result means.
deliverables: opening_report.md stating both pre-registrations, the null objects, the Section 8 determinations, and what each contract cannot do

EXP-HEUR-d640d9 specifies NC-3/NC-6: the first direct test of Heuristic 1 at toy scale on ground truth, covering the sampler-uniformity two-sample test (RT-H2), the ell=2 parity statistic of the minimal degree (RT-H3, the one small prime the producer's nondegeneracy argument does not cover), the size-model double fit (RT-H1), and the disjointness ratio (RT-H4/NC-6). objective: GOAL-P13-001 BATCH-004, the first UNCAPPED batch (DEC-20260802-fa3b26). Its primary objective is NC-3/NC-6: the first direct test of Heuristic 1's tail at the operating point, which multiplies all eighteen margin rows through P0 and has gone untested for three batches. Alongside it, three cheap items close out the c-programme honestly: NC2d-PROPER retires the FIRED FC-4 falsifier BY MEASUREMENT rather than by post-hoc restriction, NC2b-SLOPE is the only gate with power against assumption L1, and L2-WEIGHT prices the entry-weighted charging correction the red team raised against its own objection. A bibliographic subtask finally executes the baseline-constant retrieval named in three consecutive red-team reports and executed in none. This batch is opened on merits, NOT on available capacity: DEC-20260802-fa3b26 guard G-1 states that the absence of a cap is never a reason to continue. It is explicitly NOT an attempt at completion criterion 1, which remains unreachable by this method.
